title: 专题：问 AI 入口改造（页头带字「问 AI」按钮、点开即新会话带当前记录、撤掉 ask_ai、抽屉顶部与收藏会话）
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ④ cross-repo topic parent (tracking). Source: maintainer. Jack in the seat thread, 2026-11-27, verbatim: 「我们的问题是右上角的问AI太小太不明显了，然后项目经理才想到要加一个按钮」 (06:27Z); 「"页面里加按钮"的需求 作废」 (06:28Z); decision card 「撤掉 ask_ai(#37834 方案 B)」 (06:30Z); 「应用不能改名」 (06:32Z); 「问 AI」 (06:33Z); 「开始做详细的专题设计，然后用fable评估，准备立专题卡」 (06:43Z); decision card 「全部按建议」 + 「同意，立专题卡，非 cloud 的任务，让 objectstack #3 座位接手」 (07:12Z).
Owner: the objectstack children go to **repo:objectstack#3** (Jack 07:12Z). The cloud children (C6, C6e) stay with seat epic:#5027#1 (cloud agent-effect topic, objectstack-ai/cloud#5027).
Business reason: users cannot find where to ask AI. On desktop the only entry is a 32px transparent robot icon in each page header, so PMs started asking for per-page "Ask AI" buttons. Fixing the one entry is cheaper and clearer than spreading buttons over pages.
Grading: area:ai · tracking · p1 (children carry their own grades).
Dedupe: searched `ask_ai`, `AssistantTopBarButton`, `chatFocus`, `favorite conversation`, `ShellPageActions AI`: related open cards #37834 (decision, ruled here), #37827 (closed by C1), #36996 (record-scoped inquiry topic; its "Done when" is amended by C0a). No duplicate.

## 维护者速读
- **问题**：用户找不到问 AI 的地方。桌面上「问 AI」只是每个页面页头里一个 32px 的透明机器人图标。
- **方向**（Jack 11-27 已定）：全站只留一个入口，改成带文字的「问 AI」按钮；点开就是新会话，自动带上当前页面的记录；撤掉页面里的 ask_ai 动作；交互参考 Attio（只学设计）。
- **要你做什么**：两个拆分 PR #37799、#37803 都超过 3000 行，要你合并，C4、C5 才能开工；C0a、C0b、C1s 是受管面，要你或 os-zhuang 批准。

## Rulings (Jack, 2026-11-27)
- Retire `ask_ai` with no compatibility shim, before 19.0 GA (decision card 06:30Z, #37834 option B). Cost accepted: no per-row "ask AI" in lists.
- The button text is 「问 AI」 everywhere; apps cannot rename it (06:32Z, 06:33Z).
- Opening = a new conversation that carries the current page's record; header like Attio (title, ☆, ＋, history icon, ⋯, ×); favourite conversations open in place; one empty-conversation layout reused by the AI home page, the full-screen new chat and the drawer (06:33Z–06:42Z, screenshots).
- Remove the 「改为问《X》？」 switch prompt (07:12Z, 「全部按建议」).
- C7 and C8 are p2 for 19.1; C0a–C6e dispatch now (07:12Z).
- Out of scope: per-page buttons and preset-question keys; app renaming of the entry; a global `@` hotkey; onboarding bubbles; a full-page chat; a new-chat shortcut; follow-up suggestions; the page block (next phase); the question card (separate topic).

## Target experience
1. Desktop: every page header ends with an outline button 「💬 问 AI」; on the record page it sits before ✕. The mobile top bar and Home do the same. Routes with no shell page header get a top-right fallback button.
2. On a record page, click 「问 AI」 → new conversation with a small chip 「🏢 Microsoft ×」 at the start of the composer; "analyse this company" just works.
3. After the first answer the drawer title becomes the conversation title; follow-ups stay on the record.
4. Drawer open while navigating: the conversation does not change. ＋ starts a new one for the current page.
5. Close with × then click 「问 AI」 → new conversation (the old one is in history). Mobile auto-collapse after tapping an answer link → reopen returns to the same conversation. A plan waiting for approval → opening goes to that conversation.
6. List and dashboard pages: new conversation with today's page chip 「正在看：客户列表」 (no ×).
7. × on the record chip → falls back to the page chip 「正在看：Microsoft」; the conversation never re-pins on its own.
8. ☆ favourites a conversation; it appears in the sidebar 「收藏」 and opens in the drawer in place.
9. AI home / full-screen new chat: greeting, big composer, example questions, 「最近会话 · 标题」.

Card numbers are listed in the audit comment below. The brightrule part (its installed `brightrule_policy_ask` action) is written into C1, because brightrule is not a fleet board.

**Critical path:** C0a → C1 (+ brightrule, C1s) → 19.0 GA. C0a, C0b and the two split PRs → C4 and C5 ship together; C6 goes through cloud. C3 can start now.
**Release gate:** the cloud pin must not move past C5 before C6 merges (otherwise every new record conversation pre-reads the record pack). The next pin card states "C6 merged" as a precondition.

## Topic acceptance
1. Button: checked once each on a page with a `PageHeader`, a record page (before ✕) and a route with no shell header; a narrow header hides the text first and never pushes out the page's own actions; mobile is a 44px icon; no overflow in the eleven locales; the accessible name contains 「问 AI」.
2. Record page: drawer closed → click → new conversation with this record's chip; "analyse this company" is answered about this record with no "which record?" question.
3. Open types: × then reopen → new; closed mid-generation then reopen → new, the old answer is complete in history and no blank conversation appears; mobile auto-collapse then reopen → same; a pending plan → that conversation.
4. Refresh, `/ai/ask/<id>`, history → the named conversation. Home 「Ask AI」 → new. Studio copilot and build apps follow A5's exceptions.
5. Chip: before the first send, switching records follows; after it, it stays. × → page chip, never re-added in that conversation, kept after the first send.
6. Reopening from history in a new tab restores the chip and follow-ups still send `context.focus`.
7. List / dashboard keep the page chip; agents without `capabilities.focus` behave as today.
8. `ask_ai` legacy metadata: source parse refusal carries the prescription; `os migrate meta --from 18` lists it; installed metadata behaves as C0a says; zero change in the four generated baselines is expected; Studio's 「问 AI 生成字段」 stays; brightrule boots on the new version.
9. Scenario cards (C6e, repeated runs): referring questions answered right first time, no "which record?", at most one pack read; unrelated questions read nothing; objects without a pack still answered (fallback `get_record`); first-answer latency no worse than pre-read. Judged on accuracy and clarification rate, not tokens.
10. C8 opens in place; C7's 「最近会话」 on the AI home opens on that page; suggestions send or fill per their mode.

## Risks
- The 19.0 GA date is unknown; C1, C4, C5 and C6 aim at it. If C4/C5 slip, C1 still removes `setChatFocus` and the other prerelease-only exports, because they have never shipped in a stable release (`.changeset/pre/36999-conversation-focus.md`).
- Read-on-demand quality is covered by C6e; if it misses, fall back to "pre-read only when the first message refers to the record". The cloud seat decides that.
